    x = observation.get('player_x', 0)
    y = observation.get('player_y', 0)

    # Prefer staying safe and central when no clear objective is provided

    #  - If resources are nearby, move towards the closest resource.
    #  - If pursuing an evader is detected, move towards its last known position.
    #  - Otherwise, drift towards the center to maintain map control.

    # Helper to clamp delta to -1,0,1
    def clamp(d):

    target = observation.get('nearest_resource', None)

        dx = clamp(rx - x)
        dy = clamp(ry - y)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Look for last known evader
    evader = observation.get('last_seen_evader', None)
    if evader is not None:
        ex = evader.get('x', x)
        ey = evader.get('y', y)
        dx = clamp(ex - x)
        dy = clamp(ey - y)
        return [dx, dy]

    # Look for territorial pressure or goals; move toward center (0,0) as a safe heuristic
    center_x = 0
    center_y = 0
    dx = clamp(center_x - x)
